goal: Evaluate the QA handoff from RV-20260528-002 and create only low-authority Candidate Learning Cards for reusable Phase 1 lessons, without promoting any card or changing production artifacts.
forbidden_changes: Working, Canonical, or Policy Learning Card promotion
owner review process redesign beyond Candidate card capture
Godot, QA, Art, Research, schema, or agent profile edits

verify.name: Candidate cards validate
verify.command: npx --yes ajv-cli@5.0.0 validate --spec=draft2020 --strict=false -s schemas/learning_card.schema.json -d learning_cards/candidate/LC-20260528-002.json && npx --yes ajv-cli@5.0.0 validate --spec=draft2020 --strict=false -s schemas/learning_card.schema.json -d learning_cards/candidate/LC-20260528-003.json

verify.name: Only expected Phase 1 and learning artifacts changed
verify.command: bash -lc 'extra=$(git status --porcelain=v1 -uall | sed "s/^...//" | grep -Ev "^(art_notes/AN-2026W22-001-placeholder-readability.md|game/scenes/main.tscn|game/scripts/player.gd|learning_cards/candidate/LC-20260528-002.json|learning_cards/candidate/LC-20260528-003.json|owner_reviews/OR-2026W22-001-placeholder-readability-KR.md|owner_reviews/OWNER_REVIEW_BRIEF_RULES_KR.md|research_notes/RN-2026W22-001-placeholder-movement-toy.md|reviews/RV-20260528-002.json|runs/RUN-20260528-002.json|runs/RUN-20260528-003.json|runs/RUN-20260528-004.json|work_packages/active/WP-2026W22-003.json|work_packages/active/WP-2026W22-004.json|work_packages/active/WP-2026W22-005.json|work_packages/active/WP-2026W22-006.json|work_packages/active/WP-2026W22-007.json)$" || true); test -z "$extra"'

acceptance_criteria: Each Candidate Learning Card contains exactly one reusable lesson.
The cards cite concrete Work Package, Run, Review, or Human Decision evidence from the Phase 1 handoff loop.
No Working, Canonical, or Policy promotion is attempted.
No Godot, schema, agent profile, research, art, owner review, run, review, or prior work package files are modified by this Learning Librarian task.
Any broader owner-review process redesign is deferred until Phase 1 closeout.
notes: This Work Package authorizes Candidate capture only. It does not authorize changing operating rules beyond the already-created owner review rule artifact, and does not close Phase 1.
